title: Become the Light That Illumines the Path

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—Haa~. What a wonderful time that was. Seeing everyone look so proud and dignified...
I hope to formally greet everyone from the stage soon as well~.

The Mejiro family event drew to a close amid tremendous excitement.
On the way home, basking in the lingering afterglow alongside Mejiro Bright—

text_block_list.name: Event Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
—Today's event was awesome, but honestly...
how good are Bright and Dober, really? You never hear anything about them.

text_block_list.name: Event Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it their running isn't that great. They brought them out like
they're the Mejiro family's rising stars, but kinda makes you worry, ya know?

From my time spent with her so far, I knew she wasn't easily shaken by mild criticism.
However, today seemed to be different—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...I must produce undeniable results in the selection race.
I must deliver a performance worthy of everyone's expectations...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: As a horsegirl of the Mejiro family, without fail...
choice_data_list: ...Hey, mind if we take a little detour—
...Say, mind if we take a little detour—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This is where... you and I first met...
Fufu... yes, standing side by side, looking up at that very tree—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? All the leaves... have fallen now, haven't they~?
Even though they tried so hard to hold on...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...My goodness! A bud...
There is a tiny bud nestled right there~!

Though the withered leaf we watched has fallen, new life is already being nurtured.
Endure the long, long winter, and the season of blossoming will soon arrive.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Is that so~?
Then spring... will soon be upon us.

Until now, she has moved forward unhurriedly at her own pace.
Because that steady foundation was there, advice was able to bring about real change.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—My... spring.
Is it truly... right around the corner?
choice_data_list: Now is your time to bud.
Now is your time to blossom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Can I truly become like everyone else?
As a proud member of the beloved Mejiro family...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Relative A
text_block_list.text:
'—Bright, you say? That child is just far too frail...
Poor thing, racing will surely be too difficult for her.'

text_block_list.name: Personal Trainer
text_block_list.text:
'Ryan runs brilliantly! She's bound for great things.
...Hm? Bright... For now, just watch from the sidelines.'

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright, what are you... oh, right. You were watching everyone.
You should run with us instead!

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Big Sister~. Will I... someday...
Will I someday be able to become like you and the others?

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Of course you will! I don't really know what 'like us' means, but...
if you want to be, you can do it, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text: So—let's run together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...I understand now.
I must have been waiting here—waiting for you all along.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
In tomorrow's selection race, I shall show you a truly magnificent result.
And onward—to my debut!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, today's field... is full of runners who prefer to race from behind.
They'll probably hold back until the final stretch, so it's going to be a slow pace.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Even *that* Mejiro Bright is in this. Taking things leisurely as usual...
If she misjudges when to make her move, she's done for. Wonder if she'll be okay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Interim Trainer~. I have finished my preparations.
So, what is the plan for today~?
choice_data_list: First, focus on your own rhythm and positioning.

text_block_list.text:
The mid-race will be a battle of patience over when to break out. Worrying about
time and disrupting her pace would only disadvantage her. When the decisive moment arrives—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Just as we practiced, seize the right moment and surge forward all at once... correct?
...Will I truly be able to win?

Her engine is simply slow to warm up, but her closing kick is magnificent.
As long as she makes her move at the decisive moment, she will not lose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I shall certainly show you a performance that lives up to your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—And they're off! In this 6-horse field over 1,800 meters on turf,
the race gets underway at an unhurried, leisurely pace!

text_block_list.name: Competing Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
...W-Wait... unhurried is putting it lightly...
Someone take the lead already... or else...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Heh... interesting.
Even for this group, this pace is absurdly slow.

text_block_list.name: Racing Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I-I can't take it anymoreee!
It might be too early, but... here I gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(...It is quite all right. I shall bide my time, strictly at my own pace.
And once I discern the moment to bloom...——)
"Bright!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(——I can hear your voice.
The time for me to blossom is... nowww!!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Here they come down the final stretch! The racers make their move all at once——
Wait, what's this?! Mejiro Bright comes bursting out from dead last?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Feast your eyes, everyone...!
I am the new light that shall illuminate the Mejiro family's glory!

And just like that, Mejiro Bright seized a magnificent victory in the debut race!
However——

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
T-Two minutes...?! In an 1800-meter race?!
T-That's so slow...! That's nearly ten seconds slower than the average...!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Wow, that's way off what we expected...
A girl who takes two whole minutes for 1800 meters is just...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I saw it clearly. Your strength... and your resolve.
I have to... move forward too...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have returned, Interim Trainer~
...I won the race~!
True, the final time wasn't fast. But the way she surged late to seal the victory off such a slow pace will definitely be a deadly weapon, even in top-class races!
With more training, her future could be so much more—As the thought crossed my mind, I realized I wanted to see the scenery ahead... to see the future illuminated by her light.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer~
I look forward to being in your care starting today~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Where I aim to reach lies upon a distant peak.
Walking such a path alone would simply be far too dazzling for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If you do not... guide me along the way.
Would you please witness the spring alongside me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...!
I am so delighted~ Yay~

And so, aiming for a brand-new light with Mejiro Bright,
we took our first steps together into the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yay~ Phew~♪
I made my debuuut too~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...How long are you gonna just stand there watching? If you're gonna be Bright's Trainer,
you've gotta lay down the law when needed... or things are never gonna get done, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, maybe it's not my place to say, but if you're gonna be Bright's Trainer,
you really should put your foot down when it counts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Okaaa~y♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Okaaa~y♪
